description: Records this session's transcript_path at start so /save-conversation can find it reliably (#23), and logs every tool call so `enchiridion tool-call-stats` can report the cost of a run (#100). Both fail open (#153): `|| exit 0` keeps a hook handler error — or, pre-#254, a failed binary bootstrap — from interrupting the session, at the cost of that hook's side effect for this run. Since #254, bin/enchiridion is a thin `exec node <bundle>` shim with no fetch step, so there is no retry-storm risk left for PostToolUse (firing on every tool call) to guard against; it no longer sets ENCHIRIDION_NO_FETCH, which is now meaningless to the shim.
